# Get Article

iOS 14 +

## Notes

Retrieves an article using safari reader.

## Syntax

~~~~text
getArticle(url: <#String (Allows Variables)#>)
~~~~

## Example

~~~~text
getArticle(url: "https://jellycuts.com")
~~~~
